title: Nice but…
body: The design is amazing but the lack of a free trial really is a bummer. I downloaded the app and carried out the first part of the registration but then the only option that I had in order to carry on was subscribing. I’m already using other apps but I’m constantly looking for new features, still 12$ for trying out an app that I’m not sure I’ll end up using is not for me. Sorry 🤷‍♂️
